sections.Profile:
The "Waterworld" pinball machine, released by Gottlieb in October 1995, is based on the film of the same name. Designed by Jon Norris and Ray Tanzer, this machine features artwork by Constantino Mitchell and Jeanine Mitchell.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1995
- In production: no
- Type: Solid State
- Display: DMD
- Players: 4
- Tags: Licensed, 1990s, Solid State, Water
